cross_validation: 5-fold StratifiedGroupKFold; subject_id used as group; all 21 training subjects partitioned by fold
limitations: Validation has been used for prior model development; this comparison is a development evaluation, not an untouched final result.
Test partition was not used for hyperparameter or threshold selection in this experiment.
CAPPIMU pressure values are regional proxies, not actual shoe FSR measurements.
CAPPIMU IMU is knee-mounted, not shoe-mounted.
Target is activity/window-level fall_related, not precise fall onset.
Dataset evaluation does not establish physical footwear prototype accuracy.
